definitions.explanation: A male child or young teenager, typically referring to boys roughly between ages 7 and 17.

examples.japanese: {少年|しょうねん}たちがサッカーをしている。
{少年|しょうねん}{漫画|まんが}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}で{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Shonen manga is popular all over the world.
examples.notes: 少年漫画 refers to manga targeted at young male readers

examples.japanese: {少年|しょうねん}{犯罪|はんざい}が{増|ふ}えているという{報道|ほうどう}がある。
examples.english: There are reports that juvenile crime is increasing.

notes:
{少年|しょうねん} is the male counterpart of {少女|しょうじょ} (girl).

AGE RANGES:
- {少年|しょうねん}: roughly 7-17 years old (legal definition varies)
- {男|おとこ}の{子|こ}: boy (general, any age)
- {男児|だんじ}: male child (formal/official)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {少年|しょうねん}{時代|じだい} (boyhood)
- {少年|しょうねん}{漫画|まんが} (shonen manga)
- {少年|しょうねん}{犯罪|はんざい} (juvenile crime)
- {少年|しょうねん}{法|ほう} (juvenile law)
- {少年|しょうねん}{野球|やきゅう} (youth baseball)
